Subject: Proof-of-Impact trial plan, evaluation rubric & kickoff sync

Hi Samir / Alicia — thanks again for taking the demo call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the trial (FinWell / Redwood DL-2027-0943):

Summary from today
- Goal: Validate measurable reduction in customer support triage time using Redwood-hosted model with your anonymized ticket dataset.
- Key stakeholders: Samir (FinOps lead), Alicia (Product), Neha (Redwood CS owner).

Proposed trial scope (3 weeks) — high level
1) Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): data ingestion sandbox + credentials exchange; smoke-run with sample 1k tickets.
2) Week 1 (baseline runs): run Redwood model against baseline heuristics, capture latency/cost metrics and baseline accuracy.
3) Week 2 (iterative tuning): model prompt/reranking adjustments + prefix caching enabled; weekly checkpoint and qualitative readout.
4) Final readout (Day 21): performance vs acceptance criteria and handoff notes.

Acceptance criteria (pass/fail style)
- Precision@Top1 >= 78% on triage label prediction OR equivalent uplift in triage accuracy vs current rule set.
- Avg token latency (p50) <= 220ms for 512-token context in your sandbox region.
- End-to-end processing cost per ticket < $0.08 (token-based estimate) OR agreed cost cap.

Owners & immediate asks
- Data & access (Samir / Alicia): provide sample ticket dump + sandbox credentials by EOD Thu 24 Jun.
- Redwood infra (Neha): prepare a dedicated trial endpoint and MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (attached) with calendar invites for weekly 30m checkpoints.
- Success measurement (Karthik): will prepare an evaluation rubric and baseline metric sheet for your review.

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (draft), kickoff-agenda.docx (proposed agenda).

Next steps / dates
- Please confirm you can share sample data by 2027-06-24.
- Proposed kickoff: 2027-06-28 10:00 AM PT (30m). If that works I will send a calendar invite and include Neha and Marissa for success measurement and SOW alignment.

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

Best,
Karthik

Thanks all — attached is the one-page evaluation rubric and a short readout template (I'll paste the rubric below for quick reference). Confirmed items: kickoff 2027-06-28 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).

Evaluation rubric (condensed)- Dataset: 10k anonymized tickets; split 70/15/15 (train/val/test)- Primary metric: Precision@Top1 on triage label (target >= 78%)- Secondary metrics: Recall@Top3, median latency (p50) target <= 220ms, cost per ticket target <= $0.07- Qualitative: 5-sample CSAT probe with product & support SMEs during week 2 checkpoint

Trial checkpoints
- Kickoff (Day 0): alignment on dataset & success criteria; endpoint details; smoke-run.
- Week 1 checkpoint (Day 7): baseline metrics and first qualitative notes.
- Week 2 checkpoint (Day 14): tuning results + cost/latency trends.
- Final readout (Day 21): pass/fail against rubric and next-step recommendations.

Acceptance note: if primary metric is within 2 points of target AND secondary metrics are within 10% of targets, we'll treat trial as conditional pass and discuss a small follow-up validation for any edge cases.

Attachments: evaluation-rubric-onepage.pdf (embedded in Drive link) — see drive folder in related links.
